body.title: Link the kernel to the constitution base and use supersystem
body.body:
## What changed

- docs/README: the kernel holds the base layer of the constitution, and a change to the members' constitution must be compatible with it or Dk Global blocks it until the kernel changes.
- README intro: Drayker is a supersystem in its founding R&D phase.
- Footer: Drayker is non-profit.
- llms.txt: Drayker is the supersystem.

## Founder

> "As mudanças na constituição sempre devem partir de um projeto super bem informado e validado feito em conjunto com o Dk global em cooperação com praticamente todos os membros de maior nível."

> "O Dk global deve apresentar uma alternativa ou uma aprovação da proposta, mas mudanças na constituição devem estar de acordo com o kernel, se não tiverem ele barra até que o kernel mude."

> "Isso apenas para constituição, certo? que já está ganhando destaque mais que suficiente, no resto o Dk global decide e executa autonomamente."

> "Com os membros podendo fazer o veto bem justificado."

> "Ela não é definível, a única definição que cabe é de super sistema."

body.title: First motions: functions, modules, immutability, forgetting, AutoML
body.body_html:
Adds The first motions to the documentation page:

  • each function performs one minimal task and reads like a document;
  • modules integrate functions in a fractal architecture;
  • functions and modules are immutable: a change is a mutant clone running in parallel, hash-linked and documented in the Dknowledge oracle until the network accepts it as the standard;
  • forgetting: unused functions and modules become fragments that take a fraction of the memory;
  • function types (the parallel function as a neural-network layer);
  • AutoML, evolutionary and categorization modules.

"State of this documentation" now says the first motions are published and what is still missing.

Source: the founder's design notes (BSDK and DFM, 2026-08-09, and the initial DFM organization design). The text follows them closely and adds no mechanism. Founder decision (06/10/2026): "Pode publicar os rascunhos".

body.title: English-only documentation; unified footer
body.body:
Alignment pass across the `draykerdk` organization, on the branch `alinhamento/2026-09` in every affected repository.

## Changes

- docs: English only; unify footer

## Across the organization

- Governance corrected: PAP is Projects & Applications, DFMP is the DFM proposal process, the founding account is `Hyadhuad`, and the governance horizon runs from the founding Embassy through the DAF into PAP.
- The veto chain specified in UID: signed, hash-linked vetoes that carry their real grounds even when anonymous; vetoes weighed by grounds, not counted; one veto with grounds beyond the decision's scope can lead to an adjustment after advanced triage.
- Direction states 2033 as the objective, measured by what works rather than by the date.
- Intelligence is a partner, never the master.
- English is the canonical documentation language.
- Documentation states its own claims and does not cite outside books as authority.

Documentation only. Nothing here claims an implemented system.

Supersedes #4, closed when the branch was renamed.

body.title: Publish the first motion for resolution on the base structure
body.body:
## What is delivered
One motion for resolution, published in `docs/`, on a concrete part of the base structure — how a function is described, how modules compose, or how the structure is meant to evolve without discarding what works.

## Why it is needed
This repository is described as the place where motions for resolution on the kernel's base structure live. None are published. One worked example would show what a motion looks like here and unblock everyone who would write the second. Drayker holds earlier architectural work on the base structure that has never been published — consolidating it into a motion is a legitimate way to do this.

## Where to start
The ground rule is published and binding: only the requirements of Dk and the Drayker platform are final. A motion argues for a solution to those requirements; it does not redefine them.
## Prior material

Drayker has earlier work on this subject in its own knowledge base — drafts, mostly in Portuguese, written before the public repositories took their current shape. It is not published yet. If you take this function, say so in the thread and the relevant material will be published alongside it, so you are consolidating and arguing with existing thinking rather than starting from a blank page.

---
This is an open function: small enough for one person to finish, defined enough that the result composes with the rest. Claim it in this thread before starting so two people do not carry the same function, and deliver through a pull request to `master`. It appears on the board at https://drayker.org/#org/fn
